# Changelog

All notable changes to `rahad-all-downloader-v2` will be documented here.

## [2.20.0] - 2026-11-16

### Added
- **Stream support** — new `alldl.stream(url, opts)` resolves the link exactly like `download()` (same `quality` and `audioOnly` picks) and returns a Node.js `Readable` stream of the media bytes, so an Express/Next.js API can pipe video straight to the browser without saving a file. The stream carries the resolved metadata as properties (`stream.title`, `stream.source`, `stream.videoUrl`, plus `pickedQuality` / `pickedAudio` when a pick was made) and `opts.onProgress` works the same way as on `download()`. Resolution failures reject the promise instead of yielding an empty stream. CLI: `rahad-dl "<url>" --stdout` pipes the media bytes to stdout (for example `rahad-dl "<url>" --stdout | ffmpeg -i - out.mp4`).
- **In-memory buffer download** — new `alldl.buffer(url, opts)` collects `stream()` into a single `Buffer`, built for serverless functions (Vercel, Cloudflare Workers) and other places where disk is limited or ephemeral. Same resolution and options as `stream()`.
- **Platform detect + validate** — new `alldl.isSupported(url)` (boolean) and `alldl.detectPlatform(url)` (platform key such as `"tiktok"` / `"youtube"` / `"instagram"` / `"facebook"`, or `null` when unknown), wrapping the package's internal platform detection. Unknown URLs always return `false` / `null`, never a guess.
- **YouTube multi-resolution support** — the YouTube extractor now also exposes video-only adaptive renditions (1080p/1440p/2160p) alongside the muxed ones, so `{ quality: '2160p' }`, `'4k'`, `'1440p'` and `'1080p'` pick a real stream instead of silently capping at 720p. The picker falls back to the nearest lower resolution when the exact one is not offered and records what was actually picked in `data.pickedQuality` (resolve) and on the download result; when the picked stream is video-only (no audio track) the result says so with `pickedVideoOnly: true`. `'best'` / `'worst'` keep working as before, and the CLI `-q` flag passes the new values through.
- **Audio bitrate + format + ID3 tags** — new `audioBitrate` (128 | 192 | 320, any number accepted) and `audioFormat` (`'mp3' | 'm4a' | 'opus' | 'wav'`) options on resolve and download. The audio stream closest to the requested bitrate/format is picked from what the source actually serves — no re-encoding, ffmpeg is not required. `'mp3'` saves the best audio stream as `.mp3` with ID3 tags (title, uploader/artist, cover art); `'m4a'` picks the AAC/MP4 stream; `'opus'` picks the Opus/WebM stream. No source serves WAV, so `'wav'` falls back to the closest available stream and reports it (`pickedAudio.formatFallback: true` plus a `note` on the download result). The picked audio is reported as `pickedAudio: { format, bitrate, savedAs, requestedFormat, requestedBitrate, formatFallback }`. CLI: `--bitrate <n>` and `--audio-format <fmt>`.
- **Thumbnail save** — new `thumbnail: true` option on `download()` (also CLI `--thumb`) downloads the video's cover image next to the video file (`<title>_thumb.jpg`, `.png`/`.webp` when the source serves that type) in the same call, before the thumbnail URL expires. The saved path is reported as `thumbnailPath` on the download result; when a video has no thumbnail URL the download still succeeds and notes it (`thumbnailNote`).
- **Live stream recording** — new `alldl.recordLive(url, { duration, dest, onProgress })` records YouTube Live and Twitch live streams while they broadcast: it verifies the stream is actually live (otherwise it fails with an honest "Stream is not live" error), follows the HLS manifest, downloads segments as they appear and joins them into a single `.ts` (or `.mp4` for fMP4 streams) file. Recording stops cleanly at `duration` (default 60s, max 3600s) or when the stream ends (`endedEarly: true`). A failed segment is retried once, then skipped. CLI: `rahad-dl "<live_url>" --live --duration 120`.

### Known limits
- **1080p+ YouTube streams are usually video-only** — YouTube serves 1080p/1440p/2160p as adaptive video-only streams, so a file picked at those resolutions has no audio track unless a muxed rendition exists at that height. The result flags this with `pickedVideoOnly: true`; muxing audio in would need ffmpeg, which is intentionally not a dependency.
- **WAV audio is never served** — no supported source offers a WAV audio stream, so `audioFormat: 'wav'` always falls back to the closest available stream and reports the fallback honestly instead of pretending to transcode.
- **HLS-manifest sources cannot be streamed** — Dailymotion, Vimeo, NicoNico and Kick clips resolve to `.m3u8` HLS manifests, which cannot be piped as a single byte stream, so `stream()` and `buffer()` reject those links with a clear error. Use `download()` for them (it joins the HLS segments into an MP4 file).
- **Buffer holds the whole file in memory** — `buffer()` on a very large video can exhaust memory; `stream()` is the better choice for big files.

## [2.19.0] - 2026-11-13

### Added
- **Playlist / channel batch download** — `alldl.playlist()` now also expands YouTube channels (`/@handle`, `/channel/UC…`, `/c/name`, `/user/name` — first page of the Videos tab, old `videoRenderer` and new `lockupViewModel` layouts both supported) alongside YouTube playlists, TikTok profiles and Instagram carousels. New `alldl.playlistDownload(url, opts)` expands a playlist/channel/profile and downloads every video to disk (default folder `./downloads`, override with `opts.dest`), reusing the batch worker with `concurrency`, `onItem`, `quality`, `audioOnly` and `subtitles` passthrough; per-item results are `{ url, ok, title, path, bytes }` or `{ url, ok: false, title, error }`, so one failure never stops the rest.
- **YouTube multi-quality renditions** — the YouTube extractor now exposes every muxed rendition it finds as `download.videos` (`1080p`/`720p`/`480p`/`360p` …) from all four sources (ytdl-core, self-scrape, Invidious, Piped), so `{ quality: '720p' }` / `'1080p'` / `'worst'` now picks a real stream instead of always returning the single best URL. TikTok HD/SD and LinkedIn renditions were already exposed and keep working through the same picker.
- **Audio-only + subtitles on the resolve path** — `{ audioOnly: true }` now also works on the bare `alldl(url)` resolve (returns the audio stream URL when one exists) and `{ subtitles: 'en' | true }` now works on `alldl.download(url, dest)` (saves a `.lang.srt` sidecar next to the video). When a platform has no audio stream, both calls fall back to the video instead of throwing and say so in a `note` field on the result. LinkedIn caption tracks are listed by `alldl(url, { subtitles: true })` via the post's `data-captions-url`.
- **Four new platforms** — `alldl.linkedin(url)`, `alldl.lemon8(url)`, `alldl.clapper(url)`, `alldl.triller(url)`, all auto-detected by the bare `alldl(url)` dispatcher, with `defineSource` entries, `sourceHealth`/`checkSources` coverage and build verification. LinkedIn resolves public posts from the page's `<video data-sources>` tag (multi-bitrate renditions + captions where present; LinkedIn Learning videos need a login and report that honestly). Lemon8 resolves video posts from the page's video player (signed TikTok CDN MP4, verified live) and photo posts return the photo list; `s.lemon8-app.com` short links follow their redirect. Clapper resolves direct video links via its detail API with a page scrape fallback (Cloudflare-blocked from datacenter IPs — see Known limits). Triller is wired to its public API and page, but see Known limits.
- **Smart proxy rotation** — a `{ proxies: [...] }` list option is now accepted everywhere `{ proxy }` is (resolve, download, batch, playlistDownload, per-platform calls, search, info). Proxies already rotated per request; now each proxy's failures are tracked, and a proxy that fails 3 times is skipped for a 5-minute cooldown while healthy proxies keep serving — retries automatically land on the next proxy. New `alldl.getProxyStats()` reports the mode, the active list and per-proxy `{ fails, inCooldown, cooldownEndsIn }`.

### Known limits
- **Triller's public service was shut down in 2026** (triller.co serves an empty page and its API hosts are unreachable) — `alldl.triller()` is wired and will work again if the service ever returns, but right now it fails with an honest "service was shut down" error instead of a fake result.
- **Clapper is UNVERIFIED from this VM** — `clapperapp.com` answers Cloudflare challenges and `api.clapperapp.com` is unreachable from datacenter IPs, so the extractor could not be verified live here; the code follows the same page-scrape + detail-API pattern as the other platforms and needs a residential IP or proxy to confirm.
- **LinkedIn is public posts only** — private posts, login-walled videos and LinkedIn Learning courses need a LinkedIn login and are not supported.

## [2.18.5] - 2026-11-07

### Fixed
- **Xiaohongshu extractor broken by a page-format change** — Xiaohongshu now serializes `window.__INITIAL_STATE__` with JS object-literal values such as `new Set([])`, which made `JSON.parse` throw "Could not parse page data" on every note. The state sanitizer now normalizes `new Set(...)` / `new Map(...)` / `new Date(...)` and bare `undefined` array values to JSON-safe equivalents before parsing, so notes resolve again (login-walled notes still report "not found" honestly instead of a parse error).
- **Test harness: Twitch quality-ladder test gave a false failure** — test [45] used the same clip URL as test [44], so the 5-minute result cache returned [44]'s cached 360p token result and the ladder was never exercised ("ladder wrong: {}"). Worse, `trySources` races sources in parallel without cancelling losers, so a leftover token promise from [44] could resolve after the cooldown was forced and clear it again (observed: token went from `inCooldown:true` to `fails:0` within 3s of forcing). Test [45] now bypasses the cache and forces the cooldown twice with a 10s settle in between; the ladder itself was verified live returning the 1080p/720p/480p/360p ladder. No library code changed for this one.

## [2.18.4] - 2026-11-04

### Added
- **Telegram support** — `alldl.telegram(url)` (also auto-detected by the bare `alldl(url)` dispatcher for t.me / telegram.me links) resolves public channel posts from Telegram's public embed pages: video posts return a direct MP4, photo posts return the photo list. No login, no API key; private channels and groups are not supported.
- **Multi-connection chunk download** — `alldl.download(url, dest, { connections: 4 })` splits files 20 MB and larger into parallel Range chunks (up to 8 connections) and joins them in order, with per-chunk retries. Small files, HLS streams, and encrypted (Terabox) downloads keep the single-stream path, and any chunk failure falls back to it automatically.
- **Search filters** — `alldl.search(query, { minDuration, maxDuration, minViews, maxViews })` filters results after search (durations in seconds; view counts accept plain numbers and YouTube-style "1.2M views" strings). `searchDownload()` picks the first match, so it now respects the same filters.
- **Per-call proxy for every platform** — a `{ proxy }` option on any direct platform call (for example `alldl.douyin(url, { proxy })`) now scopes that call through the proxy; previously only the bare dispatcher and `download()` honored it. Search requests (`alldl.search` / `searchDownload`) also accept `{ proxy }` and tunnel through an HTTP proxy with CONNECT, so a China-exit proxy can now cover Douyin/Xiaohongshu lookups end to end.

### Changed
- **Automatic download resume on failure** — a file download interrupted mid-stream now retries automatically (same `{ retries }` option as resolving, default 3) and resumes from the bytes already written when the server supports Ranges, instead of failing and forcing a manual re-download with `resume: true`.

## [2.18.3] - 2026-11-03

### Fixed
- **VK extractor broken by VK's player migration** — `video_ext.php` now returns a JavaScript SPA shell with no stream URLs in the HTML, so every VK download failed with "No video URL found". Added a new `vk:al-video` source that reads the player parameters from VK's `al_video.php` endpoint (progressive MP4 qualities plus HLS fallback); the old embed source stays as a fallback. Verified live: the suite's VK test video resolves to 720p/480p/360p/240p MP4 streams that serve real video bytes.

## [2.18.2] - 2026-10-30

### Fixed
- **Reddit vxreddit source was dead** — `viaVxReddit` sent the `facebookexternalhit/1.1` user agent through a `VXREDDIT_UA` constant that was never defined, so every vxreddit call threw a ReferenceError before any HTTP request and the chain silently fell back to arctic HLS. The constant is now defined in `src.js`, so the vxreddit muxed-MP4 primary works again (verified: `vxreddit.com/redditvideo.mp4` with video + audio).

## [2.18.1] - 2026-10-23

### Fixed
- **Batch API shape mismatch** — `alldl.batch()` (new in 2.18.0) returns `{ url, ok: true, result }` / `{ url, ok: false, error }` as documented, but the CLI (`rahad-dl --batch` / `--batch-file`) still read the old `item.success` field, so every batch run reported "0 succeeded" and skipped all downloads. The CLI now reads `item.ok` and uses the documented `onProgress(done, total, item)` callback (it was passing `onItem`, which `batch()` ignores, so per-URL progress lines never printed).
- **Type definitions for the Batch API** — `index.d.ts` declared the stale `success`-based `BatchItem` shape and an `onItem` option; both now match the real 2.18.0 API: `BatchItem = { ok: true; url; result: NormalizedResult } | { ok: false; url; error: string }` and `BatchOptions.onProgress`.

## [2.18.0] - 2026-10-23

### Added
- **NicoNico support** — `alldl.niconico(url)` (also auto-detected by the bare `alldl(url)` dispatcher for nicovideo.jp links) resolves videos through NicoNico's own watch-page state plus the player's first-party access-rights endpoint and returns a signed HLS master playlist with the available quality ladder. Anonymous/guest access is capped per video (360p on older uploads, up to 720p on newer ones); full quality needs a NicoNico account. HLS only — NicoNico serves no progressive MP4.
- **Keyword search** — `alldl.search(query, { platform: "youtube" | "tiktok", limit })` returns normalized results, and `alldl.searchDownload(query, opts)` searches and resolves the top hit in one call, returning `{ query, picked, result }`. YouTube search scrapes YouTube's own results page; TikTok search uses the tikwm feed-search endpoint (TikTok's own search API is signature-walled).
- **Batch API** — `alldl.batch(urls, { concurrency, onProgress, itemOpts })` resolves many URLs with bounded concurrency (default 3, max 10), reports progress as `onProgress(done, total, item)`, and returns an ordered array of `{ url, ok: true, result }` / `{ url, ok: false, error }` — one failure never stops the rest.
- **Cookie support** — `alldl.setCookie(platform, cookie)` / `alldl.clearCookies([platform])` attach your own session cookie to a platform's self-scrape source, for private or age-gated Facebook/Instagram content. A per-call `{ cookie }` option works on any platform call too.
- **Result cache** — repeat lookups of the same URL are served from an in-memory cache (5-minute TTL by default; tune with `RAHAD_CACHE_TTL_MS`, `0` disables). Bypass per call with `{ cache: false }`; manage with `alldl.clearCache()` and inspect with `alldl.cacheStats()`.
- **Naver TV** — `alldl.naver(url)` is wired for tv.naver.com links, but Naver ended the Naver TV service on 2026-09-30 and the site now serves only a termination notice, so calls return that explanation instead of a download.

### Changed
- **Parallel source racing** — a platform's sources now race concurrently and the first success wins, instead of running one by one, so a slow or dead source no longer adds its full timeout to every request. Per-source health tracking (3 failures → 10-minute cooldown) still applies; single-source platforms are unchanged.
- **Type definitions completed** — `index.d.ts` now declares the full 2.18.0 API surface: `niconico`, `naver`, `search`, `searchDownload`, `setCookie`, `clearCookies`, `clearCache`, `cacheStats`, plus the `SearchOptions` / `SearchResultItem` / `SearchDownloadResult` / `CacheStats` types.

### Fixed
- **`src/search.js` missing from the published file set** — `package.json` `files` now includes it, so the search feature actually ships in the tarball.

## [2.17.1] - 2026-10-23

### Added
- **Third-party API fallbacks restored as last-resort sources** — the APIs removed in 2.17.0 are back, but only at the END of each chain, so they run solely when the package's own scrapers and first-party fallbacks fail: TikTok (tikwm, ssstik, tiktokio, nntech, tiktok-downbloder), Facebook (fdown.co.in), Instagram (snapinsta.lc), Reddit (vxreddit, arctic-shift), YouTube (Invidious, Piped x2, nntech), X/Twitter (savetwitter, vxtwitter, fxtwitter), Kwai (kwaivideosaver worker), Snapchat (getindevice, now sends a browser User-Agent so its token endpoint accepts the request).

### Changed
- **Comment-free codebase** — every comment was removed from all code files (`src.js`, `index.js` build, `src/selfscrape/*.js`, `bin/*`, `test.js`, `build-light.js`, `index.mjs`, `index.d.ts`, `Dockerfile`). Code only; behavior unchanged (verified: build passes, 57 functions, live downloads OK).

### Fixed
- **TikTok photo posts now return their pictures** — photo/slideshow posts previously came back as a false success whose download links were only the slideshow's music track. The self-scrape now extracts `imagePost` images: photo posts return `data.type: "photo"` with a `data.images` URL array (also exposed by the normalized `alldl(url)` response), the audio URL stays in `download.music` only, and the tikwm fallback passes its `images` through the same way. Normal video posts are unchanged.
- **Pinterest self-scrape misdetected video pins as images** — the Relay `Pin` payload carries `videos: null` and no `isVideo` flag; the renditions live in `videoList*` fields nested under `storyPinData.pages[].blocks[].videoDataV2`. `shapePin` now collects video roots from every `videoList*` node (recursive), derives the pin type from actual findings, and detects HLS-only pins (which throw so the chain falls through to the legacy sources). Added an HTML `expMp4` regex fallback in `getPin` for requests where the Relay payload omits the renditions entirely.
- **Twitch gql-ladder test isolation** — the new `twitch:selfscrape` first source shadowed the ladder source in test [45]; the test now also cools `twitch:selfscrape` so the ladder is exercised directly.

### Changed
- **Test [33] updated for the 2.17.0 chain** — Piped/Invidious were removed in 2.17.0, so the stale "Piped (invidious forced down)" test now verifies the `youtube:ytdl` fallback with `youtube:selfscrape` forced down.

## [2.17.0] - 2026-10-23

### Fixed
- **Instagram carousel `playlist()` now returns every media item** — `fetchInstagramCarousel` used to stop at the primary media whenever the self-scrape succeeded, so carousel posts yielded 1 item instead of all of them. The self-scrape now exposes `data.carousel` (every `carousel_media` child resolved with the same primary-media logic) and the playlist collector enumerates it; single-media posts are unchanged.

### Changed
- **Downloads for 15 platforms are now direct self scrapes** — TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Threads, X/Twitter, Reddit, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Twitch, SoundCloud, YouTube, Snapchat, Kwai and Likee resolve through the package's own scrapers (ported from the social-downloader-api project), which read each platform's own pages/endpoints. They are the first source in every chain; the previous in-package direct scrapes (Facebook GraphQL, Instagram embed, Twitch GQL, SoundCloud widget, YouTube ytdl-core, Reddit v.redd.it, etc.) remain as fallbacks.
- **YouTube playlists** (`alldl.playlist`) now scrape the playlist page's `ytInitialData` directly.
- **YouTube subtitles** (`alldl.subtitles`, subtitle track listing) now use only the first-party InnerTube caption tracks via ytdl-core.

### Removed
- **All third-party downloader APIs for those 15 platforms** — tikwm, ssstik, tiktokio, nntech and tiktok-downbloder (TikTok); fdown.co.in (Facebook); snapinsta.lc (Instagram, including the carousel collector); savetwitter/vxtwitter/fxtwitter (X); vxreddit and the arctic-shift API (Reddit); kwaivideosaver worker (Kwai); getindevice (Snapchat); Invidious and Piped (YouTube downloads, playlists and subtitles).
- Known remaining third-party usage: TikTok *user-post listing* in `alldl.playlist` still uses the tikwm API (no direct alternative exists yet — TikTok's signed API blocks unsigned clients), and platforms outside the 15 above (e.g. CapCut, TeraBox, Moj) keep their existing sources.

## [2.16.3] - 2026-10-20

### Removed
- **Dead Instagram cookie loader** — `getActiveCookie()` and its supporting cache/rate-limiter (`_cookieCache`, `_igLimiter`, `enforceLimiter`) were left over from the old cookie-based Instagram flow. Instagram has used the cookie-free snapinsta source since 2.0.x and nothing called the loader anymore, so the whole block is gone. The npm-c remote kill switch (`getRemoteConfig` / `checkRemoteAccess`) is unchanged.

## [2.16.2] - 2026-10-20

### Added
- **Update notifier** — once per process, shortly after the package loads, it checks the npm registry and prints a small boxed notice when a newer version is published (e.g. `2.16.1 → 2.16.2` plus the `npm install rahad-all-downloader-v2@latest` command). Fire-and-forget: it never blocks or breaks downloads and stays silent on any network failure. Opt out with `RAHAD_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`.

### Fixed
- **TikTok `info()` metadata** — TikTok's oEmbed endpoint stopped returning `title`/`author_name`/`thumbnail_url` (only the embed iframe now), so `info()` on TikTok links returned empty metadata. It now falls back to the tikwm API (already the package's primary TikTok source) for title, author, and cover thumbnail when oEmbed fields are missing.
- **Bandcamp bot-challenge detection** — Bandcamp's Fastly WAF started serving a "Client Challenge" page to Node TLS fingerprints (curl from the same network still passes). The scraper now detects the challenge page and fails honestly instead of reporting "video not found"; `friendlyError` also reports bot challenges as such instead of mislabeling them "requires login".
- **Test [52] bilibili** — Bilibili began returning HTTP 412 `{"code":-412,"message":"request was banned"}` to datacenter IPs (passed 2026-10-19). IP-level ban, no code fix possible — the test now skips honestly on the 412-ban pattern like the other environmental skips.
- **Pinterest progressive MP4 (desktop pages)** — Pinterest's desktop pin pages stopped embedding progressive `expMp4` MP4 URLs (HLS master only), while the mobile-UA page still serves them. The desktop scrape now falls through to the mobile-UA fallback when no progressive MP4 is found, so `pinterest()` still returns progressive MP4 (muxed audio) first; HLS remains the last resort via the fallback.

## [2.16.1] - 2026-10-19

### Fixed
- **Reddit downloads** — `alldl.download()` on Reddit links no longer fails with "HLS playlist too large (>4000 segments)". The HLS detector matched `.m3u8` inside the vxreddit proxy URL's *encoded query params* (its `audio_url` parameter ends with `.m3u8`) and fed MP4 bytes into the playlist parser. Detection now checks the URL path only (`looksLikeHlsUrl()`), so proxy MP4 URLs download directly while genuine `.m3u8` URLs (including `?`/`#`-suffixed ones) still use the HLS segment downloader.
- **Test [48]** — the HLS download test now also skips honestly on v.redd.it CDN stalls/blocks from datacenter IPs (previously only test-wrapper timeouts skipped); the HLS machinery itself stays covered by the passing vimeo/kick HLS tests.

## [2.15.0] - 2026-10-17

### Added
- **Subtitle track listing** — `alldl(url, { subtitles: true })` now attaches `data.subtitles = [{ lang, name, url }]` for YouTube (innertube `captionTracks` via ytdl-core, with an Invidious listing fallback) and TikTok (page-embedded `subtitleInfos` where the video has captions). Returns `[]` — never throws — when a platform has none or is unsupported.
- **`alldl.subtitlesToSrt(input)`** — public VTT / TTML / srv3-XML → SRT converter (already-SRT text passes through unchanged); never throws, returns `""` on unparseable input.
- **CLI `--subs [lang]` now downloads the video + `.srt` side by side** — picks `en` when present, else the first available track. Subtitle-only downloads remain available via `alldl.subtitles(url, { lang, dest })`.

### Changed
- VTT → SRT conversion now also accepts `MM:SS.mmm` cue timestamps (in addition to `HH:MM:SS.mmm`).

## [2.14.1] - 2026-10-17

### Changed
- **Repo moved to `MR-RABBY-404`** — package repository, bugs, homepage, README badges/links, and demo page canonical URL now point to `MR-RABBY-404/rahad-all-downloader-v2`; live demo at `https://mr-rabby-404.github.io/rahad-all-downloader-v2/`.

## [2.14.0] - 2026-10-16

### Added — 15 new platforms
- **Dropbox** — `alldl.dropbox(url)` converts share links to direct download via the `dl=1` trick.
- **Internet Archive** — `alldl.archiveorg(url)` returns downloadable files via the public metadata API.
- **Apple Podcasts** — `alldl.applepodcasts(url)` returns the episode audio via the iTunes lookup API.
- **Audius** — `alldl.audius(url)` resolves tracks via the public discovery API and returns the stream URL.
- **Streamable** — `alldl.streamable(url)` extracts the signed MP4 from the video page.
- **Tumblr** — `alldl.tumblr(url)` returns direct MP4 via oEmbed + embed page (bypasses the bot wall).
- **Bluesky** — `alldl.bluesky(url)` returns the HLS playlist via the public ATProto API.
- **Hearthis.at** — `alldl.hearthisat(url)` returns the MP3 stream via the download redirect.
- **Free Music Archive** — `alldl.freemusicarchive(url)` returns the MP3 stream via the track page.
- **Box.com** — `alldl.boxcom(url)` (alias `alldl.box`) resolves share links via the download endpoint.
- **OneDrive** — `alldl.onedrive(url)` resolves public shares via the Microsoft shares API.
- **Loom** — `alldl.loom(url)` extracts the signed HLS from the share page.
- **Rutube** — `alldl.rutube(url)` returns the HLS playlist via the play options API.
- **OK.ru** — `alldl.okru(url)` extracts MP4 qualities from the video page data.
- **BitChute** — `alldl.bitchute(url)` returns direct MP4 via the beta video API.

### Fixed
- **SoundCloud** — client_id discovery now fetches JS bundles sequentially (parallel requests were rate-limited by egress proxies).

### Notes
- LinkedIn skipped (login-walled). Jamendo skipped (demo API keys unreliable). SoundClick skipped (Cloudflare bot-wall). File.io skipped (API dead after SPA migration).


## [2.13.0] - 2026-10-16

### Added — 12 new platforms
- **Deezer** — `alldl.deezer(url)` returns the 30-second MP3 preview via the public `api.deezer.com` track API (full tracks are DRM-protected).
- **Apple Music** — `alldl.applemusic(url)` returns the 30-second MP3 preview via the public iTunes lookup API.
- **Bandcamp** — `alldl.bandcamp(url)` extracts the track MP3 stream from the page's `data-tralbum` JSON (uses native fetch — Bandcamp's WAF blocks axios/Node-http TLS fingerprints).
- **Pixeldrain** — `alldl.pixeldrain(url)` resolves file metadata + direct download via the public Pixeldrain API.
- **Gofile** — `alldl.gofile(url)` discovers an active server then resolves content metadata + direct download links.
- **Odysee** — `alldl.odysee(url)` resolves the LBRY URI via the public proxy API and returns the direct MP4 stream URL.
- **PeerTube** — `alldl.peertube(url)` works on any instance: fetches `/api/v1/videos/<uuid>` and returns the best MP4 or HLS playlist.
- **Kick** — `alldl.kick(url)` returns the clip HLS stream via the public clips API v2.
- **VK Video** — `alldl.vk(url)` extracts MP4 qualities (1080p–240p) from the `video_ext.php` embed page (URLs are IP-bound and expiring — download promptly).
- **Weibo** — `alldl.weibo(url)` returns video MP4s (hd/720p/ld) via the `m.weibo.cn` statuses API.
- **Mixcloud** — `alldl.mixcloud(url)` returns the show audio stream via the public GraphQL API (XOR-decrypted stream URL).
- **Audiomack** — `alldl.audiomack(url)` returns the track audio stream via the OAuth 1.0a-signed play API (uses the public `audiomack-web` client credential).
- Type definitions added for all 12 new methods.

### Notes
- Kuaishou was researched but is bot-walled from datacenter IPs — no unverified resolver shipped.

## [2.10.0] - 2026-10-14

### Added — extended quality selection
- **Explicit heights**: `quality: '720p' | '1080p' | '480p' | '360p'` (bare numbers like `720` work too) — picks the closest stream at or under the target height (never upscales); when nothing fits under it, the smallest stream above it.
- **`quality: 'worst'`** — the lowest-quality stream.
- **`opts.maxHeight`** (e.g. `{ maxHeight: 720 }`) — highest stream with height ≤ maxHeight; works on `alldl(url, opts)` and `alldl.download(url, dest, opts)`. An explicit height in `quality` wins over `maxHeight`.
- Existing values (`best` | `high` | `medium` | `low` | `audio`) are unchanged; CLI `-q/--quality` accepts the new values too.

### Added — Instagram carousel playlists
- `alldl.playlist('https://www.instagram.com/p/SHORTCODE/')` now returns **every** media item (videos + photos) of a carousel/album post.
- Entries carry `mediaUrl` (a direct CDN URL) in addition to `url` — the CLI `--playlist` flow downloads `mediaUrl` directly, skipping the re-resolve step. Works with the existing `{ limit }` option.

### Added — consistent `info()` shape
- Every `alldl.info(url)` result now carries `platform` (alias of `site`) and `uploader` (alias of `author.name`), so all sites return the same shape: `{ site, platform, url, title, author:{name,url}, uploader, thumbnail, duration, description }`. No existing fields changed.
- Removed the last non-English string in the Meta oEmbed description (English only, per project rule).

### Added — CLI batch file input
- `rahad-dl --batch-file ./urls.txt` — reads one URL per line (skips blank lines and `#` comments), downloads all with the existing batch flow (concurrency 3), prints per-URL ✅/❌ lines plus a final `X succeeded, Y failed` summary.
- `bin/rahad-dl.js` is now require-safe: the CLI entry is guarded by `require.main === module` and `parseArgs` / `parseBatchFile` / `HELP` are exported for tests.

### Added — new platforms: Rumble + Twitch Clips
- **Rumble** (`alldl.rumble(url)`, auto-detect via router, `alldl.info(url)`): `rumble.com/api/Media/oembed.json?url=<page-url>` → real embed ID from the `html` iframe (the page-slug ID is NOT the embed ID — it 410s) → `rumble.com/embed/<embedId>/` → `"mp4".url` (direct MP4) or `"hls".url` (master m3u8) fallback. Source: `rumble:oembed-embed`.
- **Twitch Clips** (`alldl.twitch(url)` for `clips.twitch.tv/<slug>`, auto-detect via router, `alldl.info(url)`): public GraphQL endpoint with the public client ID (no OAuth). Source A `twitch:gql-token` (primary): inline `playbackAccessToken` query → `clip_uri` signed 360p MP4 — no persisted-query hash to maintain. Source B `twitch:gql-ladder`: persisted `ShareClipRenderStatus` query → `assets[0].videoQualities[]` signed 1080p/720p/480p/360p ladder with full `videos[]` + `qualities` map (quality selection works: `{ quality: '720p' }`).

### Added — new sources for existing platforms
- **Reddit**: NEW primary `reddit:vxreddit` — `vxreddit.com{post_path}` with the `facebookexternalhit/1.1` crawler UA server-renders `<meta property="og:video">` → muxed MP4 (video + audio, no merge needed). FIXED `reddit:arctic`: now uses the post's `url` field (`v.redd.it/<vid>` → `HLSPlaylist.m3u8` master) instead of `media.reddit_video` (arctic-shift strips it to null on some posts). NEW `reddit:vreddit`: direct `v.redd.it/<vid>` links → HLS master. Chain: vxreddit → arctic-shift → v.redd.it direct.
- **Pinterest**: verified pin-page pattern is now primary — `https://v1.pinimg.com/videos/iht/expMp4/..._<width>w.mp4` regex, widest rendition first (progressive MP4 with muxed audio); HLS master as backup; `i.pinimg.com/originals/...` for image pins. Source: `pinterest:scrape`.
- **Josh**: NEW primary `josh:cdn` — the share-link UUID maps deterministically to `https://saz.myjosh.in/stream-az/prod-ugc-contents/mp4/{uuid}/{uuid}_h_720.mp4` (`h_480` fallback), verified with HEAD before returning — no page fetch needed. `josh:pagemeta` (`__NEXT_DATA__`) kept for metadata fallback.
- **Vimeo**: NEW primary `vimeo:playerconfig` — `player.vimeo.com/video/<id>` → inline `window.playerConfig` → `request.files.hls.cdns[<default_cdn>].url` (signed HLS master). The legacy progressive-MP4 scrape (`vimeo:api`) is kept as fallback. `info()` now tries the (still alive) v2 API first, then oEmbed.
- **Dailymotion**: player-metadata source kept (works — returns HLS). `info()` now falls back to the public data API and oEmbed. Honest gap: no second no-auth MP4 source exists (stream fields are OAuth-only) — documented, not faked.

### Added — HLS (.m3u8) downloads actually save video
- `alldl.download()` on an HLS stream no longer saves the playlist text: a pure-JS segment downloader (no ffmpeg needed) walks master → variant (honors `quality`/`maxHeight`) → media playlist, downloads segments with bounded concurrency, supports `EXT-X-MAP` init, `EXT-X-BYTERANGE`, and AES-128, then concatenates to `.mp4` (fMP4) or `.ts` (MPEG-TS). Applies to Dailymotion, Vimeo, Rumble-HLS, Pinterest-HLS, and Reddit HLS fallbacks.

### Honest gaps (2.10.0)
- Dailymotion: no second no-auth MP4 source exists (stream fields need OAuth `can-read-video-streams`); the cdndirector CDN 403s from datacenter IPs but should work from residential IPs.
- Reddit galleries (`gallery_data`/`media_metadata`): unverified — arctic-shift strips the `media` object; single-image posts work via `preview.images`.
- Pinterest `pin.it` short links: expansion not live-tested (axios follows 302s by default, expected to work).
- Vimeo `/config` endpoint and Rumble homepage: 403 from datacenter IPs (bot mitigation); the implemented paths avoid them.
- From restricted networks, `vxreddit.com`/`rumble.com` may need a residential IP (observed: TLS stalls from one datacenter VM while curl via proxy works).

## [2.9.0] - 2026-10-13

### Added — fallback chains: the package now (almost) never goes down
- **Ordered multi-source fallback per platform**: every platform downloader now tries its sources in order and automatically moves to the next one when a source fails. One API down no longer means the platform is down.
- **Source health tracking**: a source that fails 3 times in a row is temporarily skipped (10-minute cooldown), then automatically retried. Flaky sources stop slowing down requests.
- **`alldl.sourceHealth()`**: inspect per-source health — `{ "tiktok:tikwm": { fails, inCooldown, cooldownEndsInMs }, ... }`.
- **`alldl.checkSources()`**: lightweight up/down probe of every platform source, returns `{ platform: { sourceId: "up"|"down" } }`. Never throws.

### Added — new sources (all free, no auth, live-verified)
- **TikTok**: ssstik.io, tiktokio.com, nntech-free-tt-api → 6-deep chain (tikwm → ssstik → tiktokio → nntech → downbloder → direct scrape)
- **YouTube**: 2× Piped API instances (pipedapi.ducks.party, api.piped.private.coffee), nntech-free-yt-api. Note: public Invidious discovery has collapsed to a single instance — Piped now carries the load; empty-body 200 responses are treated as failures.
- **Twitter/X**: fxtwitter API (`api.fxtwitter.com`) with per-bitrate MP4 formats — quality selection now picks real 720p/1080p renditions.
- **Snapchat**: official Spotlight page scrape (og:video / __NEXT_DATA__) as primary; getindevice as fallback.
- **Kwai**: official PWA API (`/rest/o/w/pwa/feed/slides`) — replaces the degraded kwaivideosaver worker (it returned empty video URLs).
- **CapCut**: official template-detail page scrape as primary; 3bic kept for `/t/` short links.
- **Moj**: code.market job API as fallback behind the page-meta scrape.
- **Likee**: `window.data` JSON parsing (from yt-dlp's extractor) with no-watermark URL trick.

### Notes
- Reddit, Pinterest, Josh: no new viable no-auth sources exist — existing implementations kept, now routed through the health-tracked fallback framework.
- Facebook / Instagram: unchanged (routed through the new framework).

## [2.8.0] - 2026-10-13

### Added — 3 new platforms
- **Reddit** (`alldl.reddit(url)`) — v.redd.it videos via Arctic Shift metadata API + DASH manifest parsing; multiple quality renditions (up to 1080p) + separate audio track. No auth needed.
- **Moj** (`alldl.moj(url)`) — direct MP4 from share-page `og:video` meta. No auth needed.
- **Josh** (`alldl.josh(url)`) — direct MP4 from `__NEXT_DATA__` payload (supports /video/ and /tiny/ links). No auth needed.

### Added — proxy upgrades
- **Proxy auto-rotation**: `alldl.setProxy(['http://p1:8080', 'http://p2:8080'])` rotates proxies round-robin per request; `alldl.getProxy()` returns the current setting; `setProxy(null)` disables.
- **Per-request proxy**: `proxy` option on `alldl(url, { proxy })`, `alldl.download(url, dest, { proxy })`, `alldl.batch(urls, { proxy })`, and `alldl.info(url, { proxy })` — overrides the global setting for that call only (concurrency-safe via AsyncLocalStorage).
- Proxy now applies to **all** requests including streamed file downloads (streamToFile uses the shared HTTP client).
- CLI: `--proxy <url>` (comma-separated for rotation) and `--batch` flags.

### Added — TikTok user playlists
- `alldl.playlist('https://www.tiktok.com/@username')` — fetches a TikTok user's recent videos (via tikwm user-posts API); CLI `--playlist` accepts TikTok profile URLs too.

### Fixed
